top_signals.title: Asia-US West Coast container spot rates fall below $8,000 as US avoids LA-Long Beach port strike
top_signals.summary:
Trans-Pacific spot rates are slipping from peak-season highs after a tentative LA-Long Beach port labor deal. Trade-policy uncertainty and carrier capacity cuts could still keep prices elevated.

top_signals.title: BOK Hikes Key Rate to 3.25%
top_signals.summary: The Bank of Korea resumed raising interest rates, lifting its benchmark rate by 25 basis points to 3.25%. The hike follows a pause in October after back-to-back increases in July and August. Bloomberg's Denny Thomas has the key takeaways from the BOK decision. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Tata Trusts Back Lawsuit Against Tata Sons Chair’s Reappointment
top_signals.summary: A majority of trustees at Tata Trusts voted in favor of filing a lawsuit to oppose Natarajan Chandrasekaran’s reappointment as the chairman of Tata Sons Pvt., people familiar with the matter said, signaling the power tussle at the Indian conglomerate was escalating.
